turns.text: Yeah, definitely. No heavy lifting or awkward bending in the shop for me right now. I miss working on my projects, but it's just not worth the risk.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Absolutely. Your back will thank you! How are things at the high school? Being head of the science department must keep you incredibly busy this close to the end of the school year.

turns.text: Oh, it really does. Wrapping up grades, preparing for next year, and organizing the final labs is always a scramble. I'm definitely looking forward to the summer break.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I can only imagine! You've definitely earned a relaxing weekend. Do you and Grace have any fun plans for tonight?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Nothing too wild. We're actually just going to order some food and put on some sitcom reruns for our evening TV show. Sometimes a little nostalgic humor is exactly what you need.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds absolutely perfect. Low-key, comfortable, and a great way to let your back rest. I hope you and Grace have a wonderfully relaxing evening!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I appreciate it. I'll catch up with you later.
